    constructor
    · intro hT hTc
      exact (hPP T hT Tᶜ hTc) (by ext x; simp)

      by_contra hT
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hTU⟩ := hmax T hT
      obtain ⟨V, hV, hTV⟩ := hmax Tᶜ hTc
      have hUV : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
        apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
        intro x hx
        have hxU : x ∈ U := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_left hx
        have hxV : x ∈ V := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right hx
        have hxnot : x ∉ T := by
          intro hxT
          have hx' : x ∈ T ∩ U := ⟨hxT, hxU⟩
          rw [hTU] at hx'
          exact hx'
        have hxT : x ∈ T := by
          by_contra hxT
          have hxc : x ∈ Tᶜ := by simpa using hxT
          have hx' : x ∈ Tᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hxc, hxV⟩
          rw [hTV] at hx'
          exact hx'
        exact hxnot hxT
      exact (hPP U hU V hV) hUV

have hUV : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
        apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
        intro x hx
        have hxU : x ∈ U := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_left hx
        have hxV : x ∈ V := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right hx
        have hxnot : x ∉ T := by
          intro hxT
          have hx' : x ∈ T ∩ U := ⟨hxT, hxU⟩
          rw [hTU] at hx'
          exact hx'
        have hxT : x ∈ T := by
          by_contra hxT
          have hxc : x ∈ Tᶜ := by simpa using hxT
          have hx' : x ∈ Tᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hxc, hxV⟩
          rw [hTV] at hx'
          exact hx'
        exact hxnot hxT
